studies.study_title: A modified Khorana risk assessment score for venous thromboembolism in cancer patients receiving chemotherapy: the Protecht score
studies.predicted_reason: This study does not meet the selection criteria. While the population (cancer patients receiving chemotherapy) is relevant, this is not a randomised controlled trial of an intervention. This paper describes the development and validation of a modified risk assessment score (the Protecht score) for VTE risk stratification. Although it references the Protecht study (NCT 00951574) which tested nadroparin prophylaxis, this publication itself is about risk score methodology, not an RCT comparing anticoagulant interventions to placebo/no prophylaxis or comparing two anticoagulants.
